title: The threshold choice
statement: Per the canon, humanity crossed at the 1945 atomic threshold into the decisive period of its history: scientifically capable of self-destruction and, for the same reason, capable at last of understanding its origins and joining its creators' level — the choice between destroying itself and entering the age of interplanetary maturity is the canon's framing of the present era, and the reason contact was initiated when it was.

includes: The threshold: the 1945 explosion as the canon's stated hinge — the moment humanity became dangerous to itself and legible to its creators as potentially mature
The coupling, which is the claim's distinctive structure: the same scientific capability underlies both the danger and the possibility; neither can be renounced without the other
The contact rationale: the canon times its own delivery to this threshold (the chronological hinge recorded at TBWTT-1:47 and carried in woh-claim-0020's report frame)
The period placement within the Apocalypse-as-unveiling era of woh-claim-0015
excludes: Predictions of either outcome; the canon frames a choice, and the corpus models no probability
Reading current events as movement toward either pole, which is the Dispatch genre's temptation and this record's principal drift line
Policy prescriptions; the canon's own proposals are carried by the normative records (woh-claim-0032, woh-claim-0033)
Any claim that the threshold framing is unique to the canon; mid-century existential-risk discourse is acknowledged context

source_references.locator: TBWTT-1:47 (chosen after the first atomic explosion of 1945); the self-destruction-or-maturity framing across the messages' closing charge
The second message's development of the maturity condition and the planetary stakes
The academic reading of the movement's nuclear-age framing

alternatives.statement: The threshold framing is 1970s nuclear-anxiety discourse absorbed into the canon; every contactee religion of the era carries the same hinge.
The choice framing functions as motivational structure (urgency without dates), standard in millenarian rhetoric.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0001 or woh-claim-0015 is revised or retired.
The canon's fuller context changes the threshold or the coupling.
Public prose begins reading news as movement toward either pole, which this record excludes.
